note: Danske Bank's price book (updated 7 October 2026), read 2026-10-30 for its Mastercards: the Mastercard Basis (250 kroner a year), Guld (795) and Platin (1,395), each with a standard yearly card fee (none inside some customer programmes, which the game doesn't hold). With the usual 100% repayment each month no interest is charged from purchase to the due date, so nothing is carried; the 5, 10 or 15% monthly repayment the holder may choose instead carries interest from the due date at a rate the price book doesn't state, so it isn't written. Each: a cash withdrawal on the credit function at Danske Bank's machines or counters costs 1% (at least 20 kroner); paying in a currency outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and Britain costs 1.5% (written as the foreign fee; 0.5% on EEA currencies isn't modelled); a payment reminder costs 100 kroner, written as the late fee. The Mastercard Hverdag+ (199 kroner a year) is offered without a credit assessment and can't be used on credit, so it isn't written. Replacement, express and courier charges aren't written. The main banks: Danske Bank, Denmark's largest, is the only one written; Nordea's and Jyske Bank's Danish card price lists weren't reached on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of the Mastercard Basis (2026-10-29) holds and is kept.

sources.said: Mastercard Basis med et købsmaksimum, hvor der ikke beregnes rente fra betalingen/udbetalingen med kortet til forfaldsdagen ... Hvis du har et Mastercard med købsmaksimum, forfalder saldoen på fakturaen til betaling og hæves på forfaldsdagen på din løbende konto.
